glossary.力量: 每层力量通常使攻击额外造成 1 点伤害。
glossary.易伤: 易伤单位会承受更多攻击伤害。
glossary.格挡: 格挡会优先抵消即将受到的伤害。
glossary.消耗: 消耗牌打出后会移出本场战斗。
glossary.附魔: 附魔是卡牌附着的额外词条或效果层。

runPlan.archetype: Strength frontload plus AOE; add block/draw to close 23 per-turn gap
runPlan.bossPrep: Demon Form/Inflame+ on curse turns (T1/5/9, pick 懒惰); block SLAP 17-21 and 淹没 30-36; Power Potion T1; hit 51/turn with Strength and AOE.
runPlan.summary: HP 38/87 after a hard elite; rest next, avoid elites, take only block/damage upgrades. Boss gap 23/turn: need AOE, Strength, block and draw; keep both potions for Knowledge Demon, enter at 85%.
